The '''Complete Century Cake Bundle''' is a {{Mythic}} item.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Complete Century Cake Bundle''' can be obtained from [[Raffle of the Century]] event.

== Usage == 
The player can right-click a '''Complete Century Cake Bundle''' to grant themselves every [[Century Cake]].
